notes.title: Madnight 2025 Has Ended – Now the Hellish wait begins!
notes.content:
[b]The World of Agony[/b] is growing! 

Dear fans! We are pleased to announce that our universe, connecting all the games we produce, is growing even more, thanks to the Tormentor, in which you will find a lot of references to Agony, Succubus or [u][b]JINN[/b][/u]

But that's not all. During Madnight 2025, we answered your questions about Jinn, Sirens, Lust of God, Agony: Lords of Hell and we revealed many details about these productions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/0936d867be95b03d0ed6aec5c258f768ff28f8ff.jpg[/img]


Madnight 2025 is over, and what a night it was. 59 minutes of pure, unfiltered horror, a deep dive into Tormentor, a fight against censorship, and surprises that left our audience speechless. But this is just the beginning.

Now, Tormentor is officially on [b]Kickstarter[/b]. If you want this game to be as brutal, raw, and uncompromising as we envision, we need your support.

👉 [i][b]Follow and Back Tormentor, now on Kickstarter:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


[h2]Madnight 2025 – The Highlights[/h2]

🔴 [b]A Night of Madness[/b]
We kicked things off with a live-action sequence starring the Madmind himself, Tomek, who delivered a bone-chilling manifesto on the struggles of bringing this art form to you, the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/e9f573d0b625eafe34e9ba97e1b2da6762cbcee4.jpg[/img]You can watch it here: [url=https://youtu.be/cNs-Bfbd9CE?t=93][b]1:34[/b][/url]


🩸 [b]Tormentor Gameplay Demo & Deep Dive[/b]
For the first time, we gave a full gameplay walkthrough, exploring the main hub, showcasing mechanics, and revealing just how deep the depravity goes.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cNs-Bfbd9CE&t=628

🎥 [b]Developer Interviews[/b]
The masterminds behind Tormentor joined us for exclusive interviews, revealing details and their vision for the many aspects of gameplay in Tormentor.

🔪 [b]Surprise Reveals & Teasers[/b]
We unveiled the Equinox Club update for Nymphomaniac and dropped a teaser for a mysterious new character, sending shockwaves through our community on Discord.

[h3]⚡ The Biggest Premiere in Our History[/h3]
To close the night, we made our biggest announcement yet, something that will shape the future of our studio. If you missed it, you’ll want to go back and watch it.

[previewyoutube=fdBuOCfpI5E;full]https://youtu.be/fdBuOCfpI5E[/previewyoutube]

[b]🤝 Now, It’s Your Turn – Support Tormentor[/b]

Madnight 2025 may be over, but the real fight begins now. We’re pushing boundaries, standing against censorship, and creating something truly uncompromising. If you want Tormentor to reach its full potential, we need your support on Kickstarter.

🔥[i][b] Follow and Back Tormentor when the Kickstarter launches:[/b][/i]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster


Thank you to everyone who joined us for Madnight 2025. Now, let’s bring this nightmare to life.

[b]Wishlist Tormentor and Join the Community server![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493440/TORMENTOR/
